request.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: desktop background environment for an established children's English journey map UI, to sit behind separate foreground character-and-courtyard modules.
Input images: Image 1 is the new approved long garden-route environment, reference for connected garden streets, paving materials, flowers and the dominant land-to-water balance. Image 2 is the original approved desktop journey environment, reference ONLY for its soft storybook finish, warm cream/coral masonry, foliage, and cheerful upper-left lighting. Do NOT copy the open sky, distant sea, giant circular lawn platform, schoolhouse, or three focal destination clearings from Image 2.
Primary request: Create one refined continuous multi-level garden-street environment with a 1536 by 1536 square canvas, fully opaque edge-to-edge, composed expressly for desktop use. A beautiful connected network of warm cream limestone walkways, modest human-scale steps, coral-pink arched walls and bridges, cypress trees, leafy shrubs, delicate trailing greenery and white/yellow flowers. Stone paths, coral structure and green planting together dominate the image. Turquoise water appears ONLY in narrow small canals and beneath selected arches, no ocean or broad pool.
Composition: elevated three-quarter/isometric storybook viewpoint, similar scale across the whole scene without a dramatic giant foreground staircase. Paths continue naturally beyond all four edges; the setting feels like one interconnected terraced garden district rather than disconnected islands. Use connected gently curving paths with small bridges and short step sets at several levels, not a maze. Concentrate the more elaborate arches, walls, plants and architectural rhythm toward left and right outer sides. Keep the central 55 percent of image width visually calm, broad connected pale paving and modest planting with low local contrast and very few tiny architectural details; foreground character courtyard modules will cover this area. The center must still read as a connected street through the environment, not a giant circular empty plaza. No designated three landing pads, no isolated discs, no circular lawns, no large round empty courtyards.
Style and light: match both reference images closely: polished soft storybook 3D illustration, subtly textured cream paving, soft warm salmon/coral block masonry, sculpted rounded green foliage and tiny white/yellow flowers. Warm sunlight comes from upper LEFT, gentle soft shadows, friendly daylight, restrained contrast. Preserve the approved environment vocabulary rather than redesigning it.
Avoid: people, characters, faces, pets, letters, numbers, captions, labels, lesson signs, stars, medals, UI, buttons, arrows, location pins, text, watermark, sea, ocean, open sky, horizon, a large blue field, detached islands, giant steps, giant central feature, a new school building. No transparent background.
